scenes.caption: The material map shows the learned masks on the corrected sheet. Every boundary must be reviewed before cutting.

scenes.caption: OFFCUT requires a mandatory human boundary review before cutting. Checking the review box is only a recording step and is not evidence that a human inspected each boundary.

scenes.caption: Clicking a piece traces it back to its source on the original sheet. No piece is invented or reused.
